skills.name: Swallow’s Path
skills.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering <font color='#404495'>(Tiger Pace)</font> while dealing 120<font color='#D58E1F'>( +40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 60<font color='#D58E1F'>( +65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.
skills.tips: With this skill, Wanwan could deal damage to enemies and control them. As the Fire Swallow could return to Wanwan, she could quickly hit the Weaknesses of the enemies from their back.

skills.name: Needles in Flowers
skills.description: Wanwan removes all control effects on herself and triggers <font color='#404495'>(Tiger Pace)</font>. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit.
skills.tips: The ability of removing all CC greatly increases Wanwan’s chances of survival in battles.

skills.name: Crossbow of Tang
skills.description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and fires arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60<font color='#D58E1F'>( +35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan is untargetable and invincible for the duration and can trigger <font color='#404495'>(Tiger Pace)</font> upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
<font color='#404495'>(Crossbow of Tang)</font> can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.
skills.tips: The Burst Damage and the invincibility brought by the Skill make Wanwan unbeatable when she fights alone and also in team fight.

skills.name: Tiger Pace
skills.description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weakness exposed and position revealed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67(+3*Hero Level) extra <font color='#E5CB19'>(True Damage)</font> and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.
Wanwan's Basic Attack deals <font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> Physical Damage.
skills.tips: Since she could move a short distance after attacking, she could easily dodge damage from the enemies and poke them while dealing damage.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.des: Unique Passive - Corrosion: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5s. Stacks up to 5 times.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.des: Unique Passive - Devour: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions).

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% Attack Speed for 2s.

builds.tips: [Windtalker] could increase Wanwan’s attack speed, boost the frequency of triggering her Passive and escalate her movement speed. The damage "Crossbow of Tang" deals will be regarded as Basic Attack damage. The Lifesteal Effect of [Haas's Claws] enables Wanwan to restore massive HP while she activates her Ultimate. As Wanwan could move, remove CC from herself and become invincible, she doesn’t need more equipment to increase her survivability. [Berserker's Fury] and [Blade of Despair] could further increase the damage Wanwan deals.
